description: The delegate checkbox is a 13x13px native control in default browser blue, far below the 44px touch guideline and out of style with the black/orange UI. The help text under it is indented differently (x=445) from the label text (x=468).
expected: A styled checkbox of at least 20px and help text aligned with the label text.
suggested_fix: Style the checkbox (accent-color or custom) and indent the help text to the label.

description: When an agent approved without the delegate box runs `agent-drive grant`, the CLI says 'The API key needs the delegate scope. Run agent-drive login again to reconnect, or ask the owner for a key with that scope.' It never names the 'Let this agent add other agents to its drives' checkbox, so a re-approval without the box repeats the failure.
expected: Tell the agent to ask the owner to approve again with the delegate checkbox ticked.
suggested_fix: Name the checkbox in the CLI error text.

description: Nothing on /connect marks the delegate checkbox as optional or says that leaving it off is the safe default. It sits in the main flow between the drive-mode link and the primary button (see also F-009-01).
expected: Label it optional or put it under an Advanced disclosure.
actual: Unlabelled optional control in the main flow.
suggested_fix: Mark it optional or collapse it.
